title: IVA 2025 negotiation questionnaire
timing_source: Section 4.1: after each main negotiation, before the between-session break
missing_response_policy: This implementation permits skipping; the paper does not specify a forced-response setting. Preserve null and its missingness reason.
scoring: Retain each item separately on the reported scale. Q8 is negatively worded; no automatic reversal or composite score is specified by the paper.

items.prompt: Nao negotiated with me like a human.
Nao determined her next offer according to my emotional state.
Nao tried to find the best deal for us.
Nao often made very unfair offers.
